title: Refresh the stale component, not just the page
when: An upgrade succeeded but hooks, dashboard or installed project instructions remain old
need: Distinguish installed CLI, server, resident hook process, relay and tracked project layer. Follow the component-specific status/refresh result; a webpage reload does not replace its serving process.
surface: Current project orientation warns on older operating-layer receipt; FIRST-USER 6/15 add resident hook/dashboard restart and E checks.
